## Checklist (the automatic checks cover most of this; tick what you verified by hand)
- [ ] I ran it locally and looked at the affected page(s) on a phone-sized screen (about 95% of visitors are on phones)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] I did not change the phone number, the form fields, the Ads tags, or any route name
- [ ] New copy follows the README rules: no "lawyer", no win rates or outcome claims, no ticket upload, no invented facts
- [ ] If a guardrail flagged something I believe is fine, I added `// guardrail-ok: <why>` and explained it below
